name: colour-wash
title: Colour wash
summary: Fills the layer with one colour at a time, moving through Colours.

name: bars
title: Bars
summary: Bands of colour move in Direction, one colour each from Colours.

name: plasma
title: Plasma
summary: A field of sine waves flows at Speed, coloured back and forth through Colours.

name: clouds
title: Clouds
summary: Soft clouds drift in Direction, thickest in the last of Colours; a good mask input.

name: fire
title: Fire
summary: Flames rise in Direction from the edge of the layer, hottest in the last of Colours.

name: spot
title: Spot
summary: A round spot of one colour at the layer's centre, or where an anchor puts it.

name: circles
title: Circles
summary: Balls of colour drift and bounce round the layer, melting together where they meet.

name: wave
title: Wave
summary: A line waves across the layer in Direction: a sine, a triangle or a square.

name: shockwave
title: Shockwave
summary: A front bursts out in Direction, fast then slowing, and fades as it goes.

name: lighthouse
title: Lighthouse
summary: Beams of colour turn round the layer, each fading behind as it passes; or stripes.

name: curtain
title: Curtain
summary: A pleated curtain parts from the middle as far as Open; bind Open to draw it.

name: single-strand
title: Chase
summary: Bands or comets of colour chase along every strand.

name: groups-in-turn
title: Groups in turn
summary: Groups by tag light one after another, each filling along its wire or flashing, then fading.

name: life
title: Life
summary: A cellular automaton lives along every strand, a generation at a time.

name: sparkle
title: Sparkle
summary: Single LEDs glint, each in its own colour and at its own time.

name: streaks
title: Streaks
summary: Lines of colour fall in Direction in lanes, each with a fading tail, or as swaying flakes.

name: ripple
title: Ripple
summary: Drops land at random spots and spread rings that fade as they grow.

name: lightning
title: Lightning
summary: A forked bolt strikes in Direction every few seconds and fades.

name: fireworks
title: Fireworks
summary: Shells burst into rings of sparks that sag and fade, each a colour from Colours.

name: tendril
title: Tendril
summary: Tendrils wander the layer, each trailing a body that tapers behind it.

name: climb
title: Climb
summary: Colour climbs each group behind a bright head, crowns its top and lifts away, one after another.

name: garlands
title: Garlands
summary: Rows of swags drape across the layer one after another, then fade.

name: strobe
title: Strobe
summary: Flashes the layer at Speed, 2 a second by default; over 3 a second fails the flash check.

name: heartbeat
title: Heartbeat
summary: Colours swell out from the centre, lub-dub, every two beats of the look's tempo.

name: mirror
title: Mirror
summary: Folds the layer onto itself: left-right, front-back, up-down or along every strand.

name: kaleidoscope
title: Kaleidoscope
summary: Cuts the layer into turning, mirrored wedges round its centre.

name: radial-repeat
title: Radial repeat
summary: Repeats the layer in rings round its centre, moving outward.

name: mosaic
title: Mosaic
summary: Snaps the layer to blocks: tiles across the façade and runs of LEDs sharing a colour.

name: polar
title: Polar
summary: Turns the layer into a circle: across becomes the angle round the centre, up the distance from it.

name: anchor
title: Anchor
summary: Moves the centre to a group by tag: the rose, the nearest tower; or lines layers up on the whole rig.

name: rotate
title: Rotate
summary: Turns what is above it by an angle, or spins it, in the façade, from the side or in plan.

name: scroll
title: Scroll
summary: Slides the layer in Direction at Speed, wrapping round.

name: twist
title: Twist
summary: Swirls the layer round its centre and winds the towers into spirals.

name: turbulence
title: Turbulence
summary: Pushes what is above it around with slowly changing noise.

name: recolour
title: Recolour
summary: Recolours what is above it from Colours by brightness, keeping its light and shade (or not).

name: hue-shift
title: Hue shift
summary: Turns colours round the colour wheel by place along Direction, and over time.

name: posterize
title: Posterize
summary: Rounds colours to a few flat steps.

name: invert
title: Invert
summary: Swaps light and dark, or turns each colour to its opposite hue.

name: mask
title: Mask
summary: Shows the chain only where its input source (or the chain itself) is bright.

name: blur
title: Blur
summary: Softens colour across neighbouring LEDs, along each strand or through space.

name: edge-fade
title: Edge fade
summary: Fades what is above it out toward one edge; move Position to wipe.

name: trails
title: Trails
summary: Leaves a fading afterglow behind whatever moves.

name: butterfly
title: Butterfly
summary: Mirrored plasma wings flow at Speed through Colours.

name: palette-drift
title: Palette drift
summary: Hues drift slowly round the colour wheel, spread up the layer and swirled by noise.

name: wash-breathe
title: Breathe
summary: The layer breathes: a colour swells up from the ground over the first, and sinks back.

name: shimmer
title: Shimmer
summary: Every LED glitters in the last colours over a slow walk of the first: sequins catching the light.

name: rising-sweep
title: Rising sweep
summary: A band of colour climbs the layer over the first colour, and again.

name: depth-wave
title: Playa wave
summary: Colours roll from the front of the layer to the back, leaning with height.

name: nave-procession
title: Nave procession
summary: Bands of colour step from the front to the back, a step every beat.

name: water
title: Water
summary: Water fills the lower half of the layer, its surface rolling.

name: meteors
title: Meteors
summary: Comets race along every strand over a dark sky, each strand at its own pace.

name: marquee
title: Marquee
summary: Groups of bulbs step along every strand over the first colour, every other strand back.

name: galaxy
title: Galaxy
summary: Spiral arms turn round a bright core over the first colour.

name: spire-helix
title: Tower helix
summary: Stripes of colour spiral up round each tower and turn.

name: arch-chase
title: Arch chase
summary: The arches light one after another, each filling along its wire, then fading.

name: rose-ripple
title: Rose ripple
summary: Rings spread out from the rose window through the whole layer, each the next colour.

name: rose-chase
title: Rose chase
summary: Comets turn round the rose window while rings move out from its centre.

name: rose-bloom
title: Rose bloom
summary: The rose window opens ring by ring from its heart, holds, and closes again.

name: starfield
title: Starfield
summary: Stars glint over a dark, slowly moving sky.

name: aurora
title: Aurora
summary: Soft curtains of colour drift over a dark sky, rising through their colours.

name: storm
title: Storm
summary: Lightning strikes out of dark, rolling clouds; more often as Energy rises.

name: rain
title: Rain
summary: Rain streaks straight down, fast, over a dim bed; heavier as Energy rises.

name: snowstorm
title: Snowstorm
summary: Snow drifts slowly across the layer on the wind, swaying and swirling; heavier as Energy rises.

name: snowflakes
title: Snowflakes
summary: Flakes sway down the layer and settle in a drift that builds, then melts.

name: curtain-reveal
title: Curtain reveal
summary: A pleated curtain opens, holds, closes and holds, over the first colour.
